rationale: Source explanation closes only the conditional negative-acknowledgement suspicion. appendEntries initializes Success=false and immediately returns for an older request. With transport success, heartbeat passes that exact false value to notifyAll; no translation from contact to positive vote occurs. notifyAll drains registered futures and calls vote(false). For an active notifyCh, vote(false) queues the future without incrementing votes and clears notifyCh under voteLock, so later notifications cannot raise the tally. The main leader loop sees votes below quorum, changes state to Follower and responds ErrNotLeader. If role exit wins first, cleanup may instead return ErrLeadershipLost. Transport errors do not produce a positive notification. These are source implications under the explicitly stated active-tally premise, not execution Evidence. They do not reopen or explain away the confirmed nonvoter-positive witness. The overview already distinguishes boolean notification, voter-only lease and match-index commitment; no map meaning change is needed.
